title: A solid 5
text: Loved our experience! One of our best tours yet. A solid 5 rating. Our guide Gonzalo had much to do with it. Very personable, friendly and knowledgeable. Obviously loves the region and enjoys telling others about it. Villages are stunningly beautiful!  Had a great meal in Pampaneira too. Highly recommended!
author: H2121GZscottg

title: Excellent day in the mountains.
text: My day was completely enjoyable. My guide, Gonzalo, was wonderful, knowledgeable and so much fun. He was attentive to all of us in and I believe he went above and beyond to make sure we all could enjoy the experience. The pacing of the tour is on target and being limited to a small group is a plus.  The scenery is beautiful. You will not be disappointed in taking this tour.

author: Kevin_W

title: A step back into time
text: Our trip to the Alpujarra villages was a day well spent. Our driver/guide Peppe was full of information and a very enthusiastic photographer. He took many great shots of us as he stopped along the way. The scenery was beautiful on the way to the villages and the villages themselves were a step back into time. Peppe was a great driver and wonderful guide. We would recommend this trip to a friend.
author: dofr

title: Fantastic trip.
text: The day was well spent. Gonzalo, our guide, provided valuable information as well as pointed out great picture-taking opportunities. He was very informative.
author: U9525OLgilbertog

title: A wonderful day in Alphara Village
text: I had the best day in Granada. I was able to experience a comfortable drive and a walk through the village of Albahara from 9 AM to 5 PM. The guide, Gonzalo, was very intellectual and explained the history, geography, and architecture of Albahara clearly, with a touch of humor. I was anxious about attending alone, but all the participants were very kind, and Gonzalo helped me walk down the sudden slope. Although Alphahara Village is not in the guidebooks for purchases in Japan, I hope that everyone will join this tour with kind staff and guides and create wonderful memories like mine.
author: Navigate28364424676

title: Gonzales was our guide...
text: Gonzales was our guide and he made sure that we had a memorable trip. He explained the layout of the whole trip and explained the history of different places that we visited. It was a wonderful experience.
author: Rafia_O

title: Wonderful experience and great guide.
text: A wonderful and totally recommendable experience. The booking management and contact with the company were very efficient, and the full-day excursion through the Alpujarras was beautiful. We want to make a special mention of the guide and driver for the day, Jose. His human quality and the care he put into it added a plus to our experience. You can tell he loves the Alpujarras and is playing at home, haha. We will repeat and will request, as far as possible, to repeat with him. Very grateful. Isa and José Manuel

He did an amazing job connecting with the kids, keeping them entertained while making the tour enjoyable for everyone in our group.

Gonzalo’s knowledge of the history of Granada and the surrounding Alpujarra villages brought each stop to life. He shared fascinating stories and local insights that made the experience much more meaningful than simply sightseeing.
